metadata.title: Kokborok : History and Politics of a tribal Language | कोकबोरोक : आदिवासी भाषा का इतिहास और राजनीति
metadata.description: Tripura has 19 tribal groups including Tripuri, Reang, Jamatia, Noatia, Murasing, Koloi, Rupini and Uchoi. Ethnically they are mainly Mongoloids. All these tribal communities have a common language called KOKOBOROK. Kokborok belongs to Bodo-Garo group of Tibeto- Burman branch of Sino-Tibetan family. The term Kokborok is in fact a compound of two main words viz ‘Kok’ (language) and ‘Borok’ (human). This language is now taught in not only schools but also at the university level. But there is a dispute over the issue of a script for this language. As of now students can choose Bangla, Roman or Devanagari script for writing exams of Kokborok.
